response.justification: While Bogdan has over 15 years of robust software engineering experience and a commendable entrepreneurial background, he lacks the deep, recognized AI/ML expertise and Director-level strategic leadership required for this AI Strategy role. His AI experience appears limited to his most recent position, falling short of the extensive AI product development history and advanced AI academic background preferred for this Principal-level position.
strengths: Over 15 years of extensive software and infrastructure engineering experience.
Demonstrated entrepreneurial experience as the Founder of GISCollective.
Strong background in developer advocacy, knowledge sharing, and engineering best practices.
concerns: Lacks the preferred Master's or PhD in an AI-related field.
Limited demonstrated history and recognized expertise in AI/ML product development.
Experience aligns more with a Staff Full-Stack Engineer rather than a Director-level AI Strategist.
